summary: 3DNow! 4x4 matrix transpose: writes a1 = transpose(a2). Pairs a2's __m64 slots with punpckldq/punpckhdq so that each output slot a1[i] (offsets 0x00..0x38) receives an interleaved low/high dword pair from two input slots, producing the transposed matrix. Pure register/vector math, no memory access, no guards, no callees. Prelabel marks it as a structural twin of the multiply helper F_4x4MatrixMultiply_243a.

operations.description: Emit _m_femms() at function entry and again before return to exit MMX/3DNow state.
Load the eight input __m64 slots a2[0..7] and pair them: a2[0] with a2[2], a2[5] with a2[7], a2[1] with a2[3], a2[4] with a2[6].

Transpose by interleaving: a1[0]=punpckldq(a2[0],a2[2]), a1[2]=punpckhdq(a2[0],a2[2]), a1[5]=punpckldq(a2[5],a2[7]), a1[7]=punpckhdq(a2[5],a2[7]), a1[4]=punpckldq(a2[1],a2[3]), a1[6]=punpckhdq(a2[1],a2[3]), a1[3]=punpckhdq(a2[4],a2[6]), a1[1]=punpckldq(a2[4],a2[6]).
Write each transposed __m64 result into the output matrix a1 across its eight __m64 slots at offsets 0x00, 0x08, 0x10, 0x18, 0x20, 0x28, 0x30, 0x38.
Return a1, the pointer to the resulting transposed 4x4 matrix.
